originals.why: In this line 'yn ôl' means 'back' (back to the city), not 'ago'. That is the wrong sense for the LEGO ~ 전에 = yn ôl.

originals.why: Here 'yn ôl' is part of 'dod yn ôl' (come back), not 'ago'. That is the wrong sense for this LEGO.

originals.why: This line has 'ar ôl' (after), not 'yn ôl' (ago). It does not use the LEGO at all.
